body.name: \(f_{\pi,ij}^{ab},F_\pi^{ab},\mathcal E_{ab,\pi_0}\)
body.construction:
Fix distinct \(a,b\in M\). For every \(\pi
e\pi_0\), express each off-diagonal entry \(R_\pi^{ab}(	heta)[i,j]\), \(i
e j\), as a rational function of \(	heta\in\Omega_{\pi_0}^{\mathrm{CA}}\) using the modified-Cholesky formula, and multiply by the product of the positive principal-minor denominators occurring in that entry. Denote the resulting polynomial numerator by \(f_{\pi,ij}^{ab}(	heta)\), set \(F_\pi^{ab}(	heta)=\sum_{i
e j}f_{\pi,ij}^{ab}(	heta)^2\), and define \(\mathcal E_{ab,\pi_0}=\{	heta\in\Omega_{\pi_0}^{\mathrm{CA}}:\prod_{\pi
e\pi_0}F_\pi^{ab}(	heta)=0\}\).
